moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off Weekend Fixtures
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is in full swing with Matchday 1 continuing with a packed schedule of games from Friday, August 21 to Monday, August 24.

angles.name: Weekend Football Fever
angles.copy: Premier League is back with a bang! Who's ready for a weekend packed with top-flight football? Arsenal face Coventry, Hull host Man Utd, and Newcastle take on Liverpool. Get your predictions in! #PremierLeague

angles.name: Friday Night Kick-off
angles.copy: It all starts Friday night as Arsenal host newly-promoted Coventry City at the Emirates! Big start for the Gunners, or a shock on the cards? Tune in from 8 PM. #ARSCFC

angles.name: Monday Night Football
angles.copy: Wrap up your weekend football with Monday Night Football! Fulham welcome Chelsea to Craven Cottage in a West London derby. Expect fireworks! #FULCHE

moments.title: New Official UK Singles Chart Revealed
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart is refreshed on Friday, August 22, revealing the biggest songs across the country based on sales, downloads, and streams.

angles.name: Chart Countdown Buzz
angles.copy: It's almost Friday! That means a brand new Official UK Singles Chart is dropping. What do you think will be this week's Number 1? Any new entries you're rooting for? #OfficialCharts

angles.name: Who's Top of the Pops?
angles.copy: The battle for the top spot heats up! The new UK Singles Chart is out this Friday. Will your favourite track make it to Number 1? Or will a new release steal the crown? #MusicChart

moments.title: Queen's John Deacon Turns 75
moments.blurb: John Deacon, the legendary bassist for Queen, celebrates his 75th birthday on Wednesday, August 19.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Deacon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible John Deacon of Queen! The man behind some of the greatest basslines in rock history. What's your favourite Queen track featuring John's iconic work? #JohnDeacon #Queen

angles.name: Bass Legend at 75
angles.copy: From 'Another One Bites the Dust' to 'Under Pressure', John Deacon's basslines are unforgettable. Happy 75th Birthday to the quiet genius of Queen! #QueenBassist

moments.title: Led Zeppelin's Robert Plant Turns 78
moments.blurb: Robert Plant, the iconic frontman of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 78th birthday on Thursday, August 20.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Robert Plant
angles.copy: Wishing a massive Happy 78th Birthday to the one and only Robert Plant! The golden god of rock, Led Zeppelin's legendary voice. What's your favourite Plant vocal? #RobertPlant #LedZeppelin

angles.name: Rock Icon at 78
angles.copy: The voice that defined a generation! Happy 78th Birthday to Robert Plant. From 'Stairway to Heaven' to his incredible solo work, a true legend. #RockLegend

moments.title: Kelis Turns 47
moments.blurb: Grammy-nominated R&B and soul singer Kelis Rogers, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', celebrates her 47th birthday on Friday, August 21.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Kelis
angles.copy: Happy 47th Birthday to the iconic Kelis! From 'Caught Out There' to 'Milkshake', her tracks are pure fire. What's your go-to Kelis anthem? #Kelis #HappyBirthdayKelis

angles.name: Kelis's Sound
angles.copy: Celebrating Kelis's 47th Birthday today! Her unique blend of R&B, soul, and dance has given us so many unforgettable songs. Time to turn up the volume! #RnbDiva

moments.title: Dua Lipa Celebrates 31st Birthday
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa, known for chart-toppers like 'New Rules' and 'Levitating', turns 31 on Saturday, August 22.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dua Lipa
angles.copy: Sending huge Happy 31st Birthday wishes to the incredible Dua Lipa! From 'New Rules' to 'Radical Optimism', she keeps delivering the hits. What's your favourite Dua track? #DuaLipa #HappyBirthdayDuaLipa

angles.name: Pop Princess at 31
angles.copy: Future Nostalgia Queen! Happy 31st Birthday to Dua Lipa, a true force in pop music. Get ready to dance to her biggest hits today! #PopStar

moments.title: Tears for Fears' Roland Orzabal Turns 65
moments.blurb: Roland Orzabal, co-founder, guitarist, and primary songwriter for the iconic band Tears for Fears, celebrates his 65th birthday on Saturday, August 22.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Roland Orzabal
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to the brilliant Roland Orzabal of Tears for Fears! The creative force behind timeless hits like 'Everybody Wants To Rule The World' and 'Shout'. What's your favourite TFF song? #RolandOrzabal #TearsForFears

angles.name: Tears for Fears' Visionary
angles.copy: From 'Mad World' to 'Sowing the Seeds of Love', Roland Orzabal's songwriting is legendary. Wishing him a very Happy 65th Birthday today! #80sMusic

moments.title: KISS's Gene Simmons Turns 77
moments.blurb: Gene Simmons, the legendary 'Demon' bassist and co-lead singer of KISS, celebrates his 77th birthday on Tuesday, August 25.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gene Simmons
angles.copy: You wanted the best, you got the best! Wishing a fire-breathing Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Gene Simmons of KISS! What's your favourite KISS anthem? #GeneSimmons #KISS

angles.name: The Demon is 77
angles.copy: The iconic 'Demon' of rock, Gene Simmons, is 77 today! Still rocking and rolling all nite. Send your birthday wishes to the KISS legend! #RockAndRollAllNite

moments.title: Elvis Costello Celebrates 72nd Birthday
moments.blurb: Influential singer-songwriter Elvis Costello, known for his diverse discography and hits like 'Oliver's Army' and 'Alison', turns 72 on Tuesday, August 25.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Elvis Costello
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 72nd Birthday to the incomparable Elvis Costello! A true musical chameleon who's given us decades of brilliant songs. What's your all-time favourite? #ElvisCostello #HappyBirthday

angles.name: Musical Chameleon at 72
angles.copy: From new wave to country, Elvis Costello has mastered it all. Celebrating his 72nd Birthday today! What's the first song that comes to mind when you think of him? #NewWaveLegend

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend Planning
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31, and many people are starting to plan their long weekend getaways.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday weekend is just around the corner! Who's already planning a getaway, a BBQ with friends, or just a well-deserved lie-in? Tell us your plans! #BankHoliday #LongWeekend

angles.name: Making the Most of It
angles.copy: Three-day weekend vibes incoming! The August Bank Holiday is on the horizon. What are your top tips for making the most of the extra day off? #AugustBankHoliday
